results.title: USF strikes Russian fuel tankers column in temporarily occupied part of Zaporizhzhia region
results.description: The Unmanned Systems Forces struck a column of Russian fuel tankers in the town of Prymorsk in the temporarily occupied territory of Zaporizhzhia region.

results.title: Before you bring that medicine into Korea
results.description: Something considered legal or even harmless in another country can carry serious consequences under South Korean law. The Gangnam Global Village Center is offering a free workshop to help foreign residents understand Korea’s drug laws and avoid unexpected legal risks, such as receiving a package for someone else or bringing certain medicines into the country.
